Method of Attack: Reboots infected computers into Safe Mode to disable resident security solutions
Installs itself as a Windows service capable of running in Safe Mode that can't be stopped or paused
Deletes all Volume Shadow Copies to prevent forensic recovery
Encrypts victim's files once system loads in Safe Mode
Attack Vector: Brute-forcing Microsoft Azure admin account via Remote Desktop Protocol (RDP)
Exploitation of exposed RDP, VNC, TeamViewer, WebShell, and SQL injection vulnerabilities
Indicators of Compromise: Malware sample hashes (available in Sophos report)
Ransom notes and encrypted file samples submitted to ID Ransomware platform
